page.title: Storage & Lifecycle
page.desc: Configure edge media mount paths, statfs watermark monitoring, dismount fallthrough protection, and hysteresis automated cleanup.

form.title: Media Storage Path & Retention Policies
form.media_directory_desc: Root path for video streams, snapshots, and exports. When changed, new recordings write to the new location while historical recordings remain playable.
form.empty_path: Please specify a directory path first
form.test_success: Path validation passed with full read/write capabilities!
form.test_failed: Directory does not exist or lacks write permissions
form.path_valid: Directory valid with active read/write permissions
form.recordings_days_desc: Regular video recordings retention period (Default: 15 days)
form.snapshots_days_desc: AI alarm snapshot retention period (Default: 90 days)
form.exports_hours_desc: Exported clips TTL survival time (Default: 48 hours)

advanced.title: Advanced Watermark & Emergency Stop Policies
advanced.high_watermark_desc: Pruning activates when disk usage reaches this percentage (Default: 90%)
advanced.low_watermark_desc: Pruning stops and cleaner sleeps when usage falls below this level (Default: 80%)
advanced.emergency_percent_desc: Forcibly stops new video recordings to protect SQLite and OS integrity (Default: 95%)
advanced.emergency_mb_desc: Writing suspended when available space falls below this margin (Default: 2048 MB)

dialog.title: Trigger Storage Prune Cycle
dialog.desc1: The system will immediately initiate the hysteresis cleaner to prune expired exports and oldest unpreserved recordings until below low watermark.
dialog.desc2: Recordings and snapshots marked with AI alarms or locked by users will never be deleted prematurely. Throttled sleep ensures 0 dropped frames.
